description: Mapping from Mattermost @handles to role placeholders for single-agent systems

role_definitions.Coordinator: Phase gates, tracking, status updates, blocker escalation, decisions ledger and artifact manifest maintenance
role_definitions.Stakeholder: Purpose, scope, constraints, success criteria, business decisions, final approval
role_definitions.Researcher: Domain research, best practices, SME knowledge, competitive analysis
role_definitions.Builder: Task titles/descriptions, JSON assembly, validation, implementation of fixes
role_definitions.Architect: Phase structure, task granularity, role design, dependency mapping, template design
role_definitions.Auditor: Quality review, scenario walkthroughs, gap analysis, stress testing, failure mode cataloging

single_agent.description: One person or AI session fills all roles, switching mindset per phase

mindset_phases.1-3: Researcher/Architect mindset - gather, synthesize, design KB
mindset_phases.9-10: Builder mindset - assemble JSON, validate consistency
mindset_phases.11-12: Auditor mindset - audit, stress test, find gaps

multi_agent.description: Each role maps to a different agent or person
multi_agent.note: Assign roles at playbook start, track ownership throughout

ai_assisted.description: Human fills Stakeholder and Coordinator; AI fills Researcher, Builder, Architect
